excluded_case_rules.decision: Do not include pronoun cases: a target referent must not depend on an unresolved antecedent.
Reject any construction whose relation becomes clear only after the target.
Exclude the verb sense of bat; both conditions use the noun.
Do not claim pronunciation understanding: use only visibly disambiguating fish/instrument descriptions.
Use explicit marine-mammal versus stamped-authentication-mark cues; exclude ambiguous closures alone.
Exclude computer-port cases to avoid a third sense in the two-way relation.
Exclude the verb sense of crane; both conditions use the noun.
Exclude modifiers such as old, large, black, small that do not settle the intended sense.
Qualify target token identity, sequence length and matched positions before freezing; no feature result may inform removal.

note: Rules describe considered construction classes, not unseen corpus observations. No corpus was screened.
